role: Persistent graph artifacts for semantic inference reasoning paths (CANON A.19).
detail: Implements first-class SemanticInferenceTrace nodes that record complete inference traversals as single INSTANCE-level graph nodes with serialized reasoning_path (JSON), avoiding node explosion. Exports InferenceTraceWriter (async record_trace method: writes trace node + REASONED_ABOUT edge to subject + CONCLUDED edge to result [if exists] + USED_FACT edges to each semantic edge source). TerminationReason enum: ANSWER_FOUND, NO_EVIDENCE, DEPTH_LIMIT_REACHED, CONFIDENCE_FLOOR, CYCLE_DETECTED, TRAVERSAL_TIMEOUT, WORKING_MEMORY_EXHAUSTED. ReasoningStep dataclass (hop, source_node_id, edge_type, edge_id, target_node_id, edge_confidence, scope_context_count). Query functions: query_traces_using_edge (cascade detection via USED_FACT reverse index), query_traces_for_node (find traces by subject), query_trace_by_query_id (lookup by query_id), invalidate_traces_using_edge (mark traces SUPERSEDED), count_traces_by_session (termination-reason analytics).
gotchas: Node ID format: trace:{uuid4}. Provenance always INFERRED (A.19.1, min/max clamp 0-1). Trace nodes stored with properties: query_id, query_type, subject_node_id, target_node_id (empty string if None), reasoning_path (JSON-serialized list of ReasoningStep dicts), termination_reason (string), depth_reached, path_found_but_truncated, truncation_depth (-1 if None), continuation_available_at_depth (-1 if None), execution_time_ms, session_id, steps_count, used_edge_ids (JSON list). Cascade detection queries use prop_* prefixed property keys (e.g., uf.prop_edge_id, trace.prop_query_id). Deprecated traces marked SUPERSEDED not deleted (Atlas Rule). Exception handling: warnings logged for individual edge failures but method completes; full node creation raises KnowledgeGraphError.
